questions.text: A firm allows its accountant 20% commission computed on net profit BEFORE the commission is charged. Net profit is Rs. 1,80,000. The commission equals:
questions.explanation: commission = 180000 x 20% = Rs. 36,000  Correct option B. Distractors: A = used the after-charging formula; C = doubled the rate; D = misplaced the decimal (divided by 1000).

questions.text: 15% of the pre-commission net profit of Rs. 3,20,000 is payable to the works manager as commission (charged before the commission). That amount is:
questions.explanation: commission = 320000 x 15% = Rs. 48,000  Correct option A. Distractors: B = doubled the rate; C = used the after-charging formula; D = misplaced the decimal (divided by 1000).
